recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the published FHIR-34155 clarification in the current build-scope narrative and CodeSystem sources without broadening into separate operation-definition or search paging checklist work.
issue_request: FHIR-34155 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked that Search Related Safety Checks for clients warn that search string meanings cannot be trusted across servers and that clients must check both the server CapabilityStatement and SearchParameter definitions.
initial_application: The historical FHIR-34155 source commit bacf6ea51e74b27baf81dad7a1e064fa6fee2f77 added a search-param-names item to source/safety.html, but it only mentioned checking CapabilityStatement search parameter and operation names for local renames. The active safety-entries CodeSystem source was later added without a search-param-names concept.
additional_context: The quoted rationale comes from the Zulip implementers SearchParameter expectation thread, where Lloyd McKenzie said clients should not infer semantics from a search parameter name alone and should use the CapabilityStatement declaration/SearchParameter definition. Current CapabilityStatement source also says behavior may be described by linked SearchParameter definitions and searchParam.name may differ from SearchParameter.code. FHIR-34234 is related background for operation naming, so this reconciliation preserved operation-name guidance without deciding that separate issue.
reconciliation: Changed source/safety.html so the search-param-names checklist item tells clients to check the HTTP server CapabilityStatement and referenced SearchParameter definitions to understand the names and meanings of search parameters. Added the same search-param-names concept to source/codesystem/codesystem-safety-entries.xml, which is active in source/fhir.ini.
source_changes: source/safety.html: revised the search-param-names checklist item to include the CapabilityStatement plus referenced SearchParameter definitions meaning check.
source/codesystem/codesystem-safety-entries.xml: added the search-param-names concept so the active safety-entries CodeSystem mirrors the checklist item.

related_jiras.note: Same block-vote family clarified operation naming; this reconciliation preserved operation-name safety wording but did not decide the separate CapabilityStatement/OperationDefinition issue.
